notes: 168 unchanged fresh live viewer canvases, 506 actual UI actions and 20 personally reviewed source sheets. Hero alignment, first Swim selection, age, both opposing axes and rotation were operated in Chromium/WebGL2; opposite Fly remains a distinct later form with first Swim selected. Main comparisons contain 81 front/right/back viewer/Minecraft pairs at 0/50/100 percent maturity, 27 Minecraft left sources and nine additional mature above pairs. Original camera, lighting, pose and normalized slider calibration differ. No source geometry, code, texture or morph formula was imported.
